warped--la-hacienda.description: A Nicaraguan puro added to Warped's range in 2015 and made at Aganorsa's TABSA (Casa Fernández) factory in Estelí from Corojo '99 and Criollo '98 leaf. It smokes sweet and woody, with cocoa, caramel and cedar over a building pepper, ending long and nutty.

thirds.notes: Pepper opens the smoke, then cedar, cocoa and earth settle in with a sugary sweetness on the lips.
Oak and sweet leather come forward around milk chocolate and caramel, while the pepper turns earthier.
The wood softens into cedar, nutty notes fill the finish, and earth and pepper take over near the band.

warped--maestro-del-tiempo.description: Introduced at the 2016 trade show and made at TABSA in Nicaragua, Maestro del Tiempo wraps Corojo '99 and Criollo '98 filler in a light Jalapa Corojo '99 leaf over a Nicaraguan binder. A medium-bodied, old-style smoke of cedar, nuts and coffee with a toffee-like sweetness.

thirds.notes: A brief burst of spice gives way to cashew, buttery cookie notes, cedar and coffee.
Cedar and wood lead the richest stretch, with coffee, toffee-like sweetness and butter; pepper stays an accent.
The flavours calm down; cinnamon-like spice joins coffee, cedar and toasted nuts on a shorter finish.

warped--cloud-hopper.description: First issued in early 2016 under Kyle and Devin Gellis's Edition One label and made at TABSA in Estelí, Cloud Hopper is a Nicaraguan puro with a Jalapa Corojo '99 wrapper over Aganorsa binder and filler. It is a pepper-forward corona that turns brighter and woodier as it goes, best taken slowly.

thirds.notes: A strong opening of red and black pepper, then sweeter tobacco, damp earth and a grassy note.
The spice eases into wood, citrus and light coffee, with a candied sweetness and anise on the finish.
Chilli spice comes back with dark leather, and the finish turns earthy and a little bitter.

warped--corto.description: Shown at the 2015 trade show, Corto is a short, soft-pressed Nicaraguan puro of Aganorsa leaf made at TABSA, with a Corojo '99 wrapper and Criollo '98 binder. Warped's fullest-bodied blend, it opens in a rush of pepper before turning to sweet maple, fruit and nuts.

thirds.notes: A heavy hit of pepper opens, then leather, milk chocolate, roasted nuts and cedar emerge.
Pepper eases and the smoke grows sweeter and fruitier, with maple and cream; one review found it darker and earthier.
Pepper and strength return, with nutty, creamy sweetness and a last touch of cedar; it can turn harsh at the nub.

warped--la-colmena.description: La Colmena is rolled at El Titan de Bronze in Miami rather than in Nicaragua: an Ecuadorian Desflorado wrapper over two Ecuadorian binders, with Dominican and Nicaraguan filler. A medium-bodied, gentle smoke of cream and honey with light spice and a floral lift.

sources.title: Smokingpipes – Warped Cigars: the core portfolio

warped--serie-gran-reserva-1988.description: Named for Kyle Gellis's birth year, this Nicaraguan puro is made at TABSA in Estelí from Aganorsa Corojo and Criollo leaf under a Corojo '99 wrapper. It pairs pepper and nutty almond with oak, a little coffee and cream, finishing bright with cedar spice.

sources.title: Smokingpipes – Warped Cigars: the core portfolio
Luxury Cigar Club – Warped Cigars guide

warped--maestro-del-tiempo-6102r-limited.description: A yearly limited Maestro del Tiempo first issued in 2016, made at TABSA in Nicaragua with a Jalapa Corojo '99 wrapper over Aganorsa leaf; the 2020 edition includes higher-priming medio tiempo. Reviews describe cedar, pepper and leather, with nutty or citrus-and-coffee notes depending on the year.
